desc: 背负式大风量，除雪清叶灭火一机多用，暗亮双场工业质感取证
leaf: 背负式汽油吹风机（大棚除雪/清理落叶/风力灭火多用）
name: 背负式大风量汽油吹风机款

shots.intent: 用低机位与雪山天际线把整机压成一眼可辨的力量感，抢搜索点击并承接除雪清叶主张。
shots.textZone: 顶部居中干净留白带：主标题位 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2D2D2D at 44pt，其下一枚橙底圆角条 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF at 16pt

shots.intent: 在干净亮场正对镜头交出整机轮廓，用一条主张把源图六宫格卖点收成一句。
shots.textZone: 上部干净留白带：主标题位 「{selling_point_2}」 in #2D2D2D at 36pt，下方一组三枚小圆点分隔符

shots.intent: 同构图同光位只改有无清理的状态，把大棚压膜与落叶堵塞的现场损失具象化后再给解法。
同一块铺装的吹前吹后同框同光，用可见的地面差替代一切风量形容词。
shots.textZone: 每条右侧一枚标签位 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D at 16pt 与 「{callout_2}」 in #E8541E at 16pt

shots.intent: 侧面实景把机器放进大棚除雪的第一现场，让种植与市政买家直接代入自己的活。
高俯角把清理结果画成一条可见弧线，覆盖园林与工地除尘的第二批买家。
贴到散热格栅与手拉起动毂上，用塑模线与铸件质感替代散热与易启动的口头承诺。
把油门定速手柄与风筒旋转接头单独放大，讲清单手操作与多角度出风的工作机制。
shots.textZone: 右侧两枚编号圆点条 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」 in #E8541E at 14pt，各接一根发丝引线指向对应部位

shots.intent: 俯拍主图看不到的背架与加厚缓冲垫，用编号引线完成背负结构讲解。
shots.textZone: 左侧竖排三枚编号圆点条 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 in #E8541E at 14pt，各接一根发丝引线指向对应部位

shots.intent: 以管夹、涂层断面与底脚滑轨三个可核验视窗建立信任，坚决不碰资质与检测背书。
shots.textZone: 三枚视窗下方各一条短标签位 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 in #2D2D2D at 14pt

shots.intent: 把易启动、定速手柄、可旋转风筒三档理由收成编号条并给出唯一动作，详情页不留悬念。
shots.textZone: 每栏左侧一行短句位 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 in #FFFFFF at 18pt，底部一枚圆角按钮位 「{callout_4}」 in #2D2D2D at 20pt

style.backgroundSystem: two-part studio field alternating one matte #16171A section and one matte #EDEFF1 section with a single soft horizon seam, no scenery and no gradient wash; real work surfaces (granite terrace #9EA3A8, packed snow #F2F5F7, concrete apron #6E7076) appear only on the scene screens
style.iconSystem: minimal infographic only: numbered rounded chips in #E8541E, hairline leader lines, single hairline dividers, one dashed accent arc
style.lightingSystem: raking side key from frame-left at 5600K that reads sand-cast aluminium, powder-coated orange housing, black tubing and padded webbing, one slim rim light, firm contact shadow under the base cradle, controlled speculars never blown out
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent premium industrial petrol power-tool ecommerce visual system across the whole set; fixed palette of base ground #16171A, base ground #EDEFF1, headline text #2D2D2D, one accent #E8541E and one secondary material tone #C9CDD1; cool-neutral temperature throughout; one font family, modern geometric sans-serif, with heavy condensed weight for Chinese set in 「」; two-part background system alternating a matte #16171A section and a matte #EDEFF1 section with one soft horizon seam and no scenery, with real work surfaces only on the scene screens; raking side key light from frame-left at 5600K that renders sand-cast aluminium, powder-coated orange housing, black tubing and padded webbing with visible grain, plus one slim rim light and a firm contact shadow that grounds the base cradle; minimal infographic language only, namely numbered rounded chips, thin leader lines, hairline dividers and one arc of dashes in #E8541E; the product is always the same single backpack blower unit at stable scale with the bolted silver volute and the orange louvred cover in the same relative positions, level horizon and straight verticals kept straight; no palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched chip styles, no invented specification numbers, no people or hands, no certificates, no badges, no QR codes, no store marks.
noDrift: no invented specification numbers for displacement, output, air volume, weight, noise decibels or fuel burn
no people, hands or operators anywhere in the set
no certificates, badges, QR codes or store marks
style.presentationRules: the same single blower unit at stable scale across every screen, bolted cast-aluminium volute and orange louvred engine cover keeping their relative positions, level horizon, straight verticals and the tube axis kept straight, harness side legible, product never overlapped by props
style.surfaceSystem: granite terrace tile #9EA3A8 with joint lines for the hero, packed snow #F2F5F7 and greenhouse film #DCE6EA for the snow scene, poured concrete #6E7076 and stone #B9BDC2 for the comparison screens, matte seamless paper for the studio screens
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, heavy condensed headline weight for Chinese set in 「」, headline 32-44pt, label 14-18pt, one family only
